title: Salts of Viridian Crystal
summary: Alchemy extract used to make Diluted Oil of Sharpness.

fields.Recipe: Combine these salts with any Vitriol to make Diluted Oil of Sharpness.
fields.Result: Coats a weapon for 10 turns, making it magical and giving +1 weapon enchantment.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
